lastCompletedStory.title: Real-git integration regression test for the dirty-prd.json bug

nextStoryContext: US-004 done: real-git integration test in test/integration/ship-finalize-dirty-prd.test.ts. Two test cases: (1) dirty-prd scenario (prd.json committed then overwritten, finalizeCycleClose removes it via git rm -f --ignore-unmatch, tree ends clean); (2) missing-files variant (prd.json/handoff.json never committed, --ignore-unmatch is a no-op, issues.local.json staged+committed). 1017 tests pass. Next story is US-005 (failure-mode hardening + idempotency for finalizeCycleClose).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Story only created a test file using node:child_process spawnSync and node:fs. No external library API beyond Node builtins was exercised.
